title: Cartoon garbage truck (cab-over rear loader; WF-v7 gold subject)
_comment: Minimal v6 manifest: target + solved concept camera + module; layoutMeasured holds only _frame.quadPx (the concept registration quad, measured by fitting the turnaround-registered visual hull's bbox to the concept foreground — no regions.json / census / layout exist for this subject). Colour families come from turnaround/views.json families.table.
